policy: audit only; implementation is authorised in Stage 4B ONLY for comparators whose definition and numerics are fully resolved. No missing comparator may be silently substituted.

CDbw.reference: Halkidi & Vazirgiannis (2008), 'A density-based cluster validity approach using multi-representatives'
CDbw.inputs: X + labels; needs multiple representatives per cluster
CDbw.noise_handling: no native noise class; DBSCAN/HDBSCAN noise must be handled by an explicit, declared rule
CDbw.edge_cases: shrinking factor s and representative count r are free parameters; results vary with them
CDbw.status: AVAILABLE BUT UNVERIFIED — parameters must be pinned and the implementation numerically checked before use

CVNN.reference: Liu, Li, Xiong, Gao, Wu (2013), 'Understanding and Enhancement of Internal Clustering Validation Measures'
CVNN.noise_handling: undeclared in the source; needs an explicit rule
CVNN.external_package: no trustworthy pinned PyPI implementation confirmed
CVNN.edge_cases: separation term is normalised across the compared partition set, so values are comparable only within a fixed candidate bank — which fixed32 provides
CVNN.status: NEEDS IMPLEMENTATION in Stage 4B from the paper, with the k_nn value pinned in advance

CVDD.reference: Hu & Zhong (2019), 'Internal validity index for fuzzy/density-involved clustering (CVDD)'
CVDD.noise_handling: not specified for an explicit noise label
CVDD.edge_cases: requires a path-based distance whose complexity can be superlinear; cost must be measured before adoption
CVDD.status: NEEDS IMPLEMENTATION in Stage 4B; correctness NOT yet resolved

DCSI.reference: Gauss, Scheipl, Herrmann (2024), 'DCSI - An improved measure of cluster separability based on separation and connectedness'
DCSI.inputs: X + labels; density-based separation and connectedness
DCSI.external_package: reference implementation published with the paper; licence must be checked before vendoring
DCSI.edge_cases: depends on a minPts-like parameter that must be pinned
DCSI.status: NEEDS LICENCE CHECK + IMPLEMENTATION in Stage 4B

consequence_if_unresolved: any comparator not implemented and verified cannot be claimed against; the metrics-paper criterion that requires comparison against modern CVIs would then remain unmet
